Since it was a brand created through a kind of fake marketing (it was created by combining TWG with a Korean marketer to make it look like it had a history), the coffee didn't taste good, and it was frustrating because the only package design, mood management, and Indian-style service (Singapore) model was introduced, making it awkward for both the service provider and the recipient.
When I first ordered, I consulted with the staff about my coffee taste, but I didn't get an answer, so I just chose the orange citrus of the fine flavors with the recommendation of the signature, but the good news is that if I had chosen nuts or chocolate, it wouldn't have been right, so I would have actually vomited. Aside from the acidity, the flavored coffee didn't suit me, so I barely drank a cup. I thought I'd have to take home a gift for my brother who bought it at a duty-free shop and give it to him to eat. If you look closely at the colorful gold leaf and orange box, you can see one of the names of the coffee origins. Although the misspelling is clearly visible, the real strength of this brand is that it is important for most customers to look good with colorful colors and a unique ~ ethnic ~ atmosphere. The price ranges from 16,000 won for 1 to 2 cups, up to 1 million won depending on the coffee ordered, but it is actually just a mass-targeted high-end coffee because the beans are not roasted but sealed and ground on site and brewed with a dripper rather than directly. Since it takes at least two weeks from the production of the beans to the store, would it be fortunate to get the coffee beans at a fine grade? It is better to find good coffee beans that suit your taste and brew them using a mechanical coffee machine at home.

reviews.text:
A coffee craftsman who had been scouted in the U.S. as a roasting expert by Blue Bottle's Korean branch started a new coffee shop after leaving Blue Bottle's Korean branch to run a coffee shop with his own style. On my first visit (2 minutes away from Exit 9 of Euljiro 3-ga Station), I noticed a small entrance that was not easy to find even with a map app, and a surprisingly small store when I entered. The interior, filled with vintage feel, gives off a retro feel to the owner. (If you look closely at the photos, it is interesting to see photos of the owner's father-in-law's wedding and photos of his grandmother's and grandfather's weddings from decades ago.)
As a roasting expert, even though it is a small store, they have a roasting machine inside and do the roasting themselves. Since I managed the entire store by myself, including roasting and coffee brewing, I had more confidence in the taste of the coffee and the quality of everything. In particular, there are pies, which are also made and served in house. (I learned this while sitting at the table and having a small talk. These pies are made from my wife’s grandmother’s recipe.)
Most importantly, the coffee tastes really good. The signature coffee, 'Roman Made Coffee', had a smooth, deep coffee taste with a deep fruity aroma, and the cafe latte was also a satisfying taste with a deep coffee flavor. I wanted to try the coffee artisan's espresso coffee, so I ordered more later, and as expected, it was real espresso coffee with a very rich, fruity flavor. I definitely recommend this place to anyone who loves coffee~👍🏻
I promise myself that I will visit again!!

Coffee Bay Myeongdong branch is a cafe with a cozy and modern atmosphere that offers a variety of drinks and desserts. It is conveniently located in Myeongdong, one of Seoul's most popular shopping and tourist districts. The bright and spacious interior has comfortable seating and a relaxed atmosphere.
I visited the Coffee Bay Myeongdong branch on a weekend afternoon, and a friendly staff member greeted me warmly and took my order. I ordered the signature drink, Coffee Bay Latte, and it was smooth, creamy, and had a strong coffee aroma. It came in a cute and colorful cup with a coffee bean logo on it. It was a delicious and filling drink, and it warmed me up in the chilly weather.
I also ordered the honey bread, which was thick and fluffy and topped with honey butter, whipped cream, and nuts. The bread was moist and soft, and the toppings were sweet and crunchy. The bread was cut into four pieces, perfect for sharing with friends. The bread went perfectly with the latte and made me feel really happy.
I spent about an hour at Myeongdong Coffee Bay, and it was a fun and satisfying time. The service was fast and friendly, the price was reasonable, and the quality was excellent. I highly recommend Myeongdong Coffee Bay to anyone who loves coffee and desserts. Myeongdong Coffee Bay is a place where you can truly enjoy the taste and aroma of coffee.

When I opened the store door and entered, I felt like I was on a movie set, and the cozy sofas looked comfortable. Since I am not from the coffee shop generation, the menus were unfamiliar to me, but I asked for a glass of Ssanghwatang.

While I was sitting by the window and looking out, Ssanghwatang soon appeared. When I tried to pop the yolk and eat it, the owner told me to roll the yolk with a spoon and eat it all at once.

I heard that Ssanghwatang tastes like herbal medicine, so I thought it would be quite bitter, but it was surprisingly sweet. Nuts like chestnuts and jujubes had a good chewy texture and I felt like I wouldn't catch a cold if I ate them.

I found out later that they sell ramen in the morning and that quite a lot of people eat it. It was served in a stainless steel bowl. Next time I have time, I would like to visit in the morning.

A wonderful place that is hard to find and requires you to reach the top floor of a small building in an alley.

If people enter a shabby building and wait for the elevator, they have come to the right place. 9th floor.

I am quoting the phrase about the philosophy of the cafe hanging at the entrance because it is impressive.

vacations

In the busy modern city, we dream of even a small fictional vacation. I live each day with the temptation to ‘want to go somewhere’. Even today, I propose this space to everyone who needs it, even if it is a small fictional vacation, without being disturbed by all the things that tire us out.

For those who can't leave reality due to a busy schedule or a situation where they have to keep an eye on their boss, how would they feel if they secretly visited someone's home on vacation? Thinking about the feelings of a homeowner going on vacation, can we also feel like we are on vacation through this space?

For Europeans, the concept of summer vacation means a month, not a week. At this time, all the stores in the neighborhood go on vacation and all the people who live there go on vacation looking for a place to rest. They cover their furniture with cloth to prevent dust from accumulating during long vacations. The space they left is covered only with white cloth, indicating that the current owner of the space has temporarily left.

'When I wanted to create a space called vacation, the first thing that crossed my mind was the experience I had living in Paris. I got my fabric motif from there. White cloth surrounds the place, and anyone who visits this place sees a space that is not something that can be easily seen in everyday life, and I wanted to give the feeling that this is a fictional space and that someone is visiting an empty house that someone has temporarily left. The wall made of cloth that runs between the pillars and the people enjoying the space beyond the framed wall placed between them also wanted to give the viewer the feeling of observing another space like a painting of someone enjoying a vacation. It occurred to me that the image of someone seen beyond that space could be the image of my imagination.

In this space through vacation, we are fictional beings, and beyond that, we may be an imaginary figure enjoying someone else's dream vacation. I hope everyone can escape reality in this small space, even if just for a moment.

plot.z

/space design /brand identity design

As it was built in the 1960s, it was one of the tallest buildings in Mugyo-dong at the time and was a building of great interest. I think one of the reasons why the old building was able to operate and establish itself well for such a long time is because it was built so well. As it is a well-built building, I wanted to preserve its unique feel.

A lot of time has passed and now, in the middle of Mugyo-dong, which is lined with tall buildings, we would like to propose a new paradigm space so that the building that was once a landmark in Mugyo-dong can be reexamined.

In line with the meaning of spending a fictional vacation, I wanted to emphasize the ironic view felt when sitting on the terrace and looking at the panoramic view, not at the green mountains with the sound of mountain rumbles or the blue sea with the sound of waves, but at the noise of loud cars and tall buildings. Also, I sat down with a cup of coffee in this space, and tried to express that I was on a fictional vacation through the fact that there was a fictional table that didn't look like a table.

Although it is a fictional vacation, I hope that this space will be remembered as a new concept of relaxation where you can escape reality and escape from everyday life.

reviews.author: Ji Kyeong-woo
reviews.text:
Whiskey bar located in Myeongdong.

Open 24/7. Always full. Reservation required. Even if you fail to make a reservation, we recommend that you call on the same day to check if there are any vacancies and visit after making a reservation. If you don't have a reservation, you won't be able to sit. (Reservations are absolutely necessary, especially for bar tables).

The store is located secretly, so it may not be easy to find if you are visiting for the first time. However, if you enter through the secret door, you will have a new experience, which is also considered to be the charm of this place.

As a whiskey bar, it sells somewhat expensive alcohol. There is a wide selection and lineup of alcohol, and in addition to whiskey, other alcoholic beverages such as rum and cognac are also sold.

Sookhee Bar has its own signature cocktail, which is believed to rotate seasonally. In addition to the signature menu, popular cocktails can also be brewed, so ask the bartender.

If you are new to whiskey, the best feature is that you can try a variety of whiskeys as the bartender recommends drinks that suit your preferences and tastes and provides friendly explanations. (You can split one glass into two half glasses, so comparing them is also fun.)

Also, with the bartender's recommendation, you can try whiskey that is not on the menu, so try to communicate well with the bartender.

There are rooms available for group guests, but they require advance purchase (purchase of bottles) above a certain level, so you need to think carefully before using the room.

They sell a variety of main dishes, but they basically serve sweet potato chips and chocolate, so you don't have to order any side dishes if you're not hungry.

It is a very popular place, and the bar is only open for one hour per drink, so consider this if you want to stay for a long time.

Since this is a place that foreigners also visit, it appears that bartenders who are fluent in the language are always on standby.
